### 💼 가장 일반적이고 표준적인 표현 (Business Standard)

**"We will send the contract after internal review."**
*(가장 직접적이고 많이 사용되는 표현입니다.)*

### 🤝 격식 있고 정중한 표현 (Formal/Polite)

**"We will provide the agreement once it has undergone internal review."**

message.reasoning_content:
*   **Analyze the Korean sentence:** "계약서는 내부 검토 후 전달하겠습니다." (Gye-yak-seo-neun nae-bu geom-to hu jeol-dal-ha-get-seum-ni-da.)
    *   계약서 (Gye-yak-seo): Contract / Agreement.
    *   내부 검토 (Nae-bu geom-to): Internal review / Internal review process.
    *   후 (Hu): After.
    *   전달하겠습니다 (Jeol-dal-ha-get-seum-ni-da): I will deliver / I will send / I will provide.
    *   **Overall meaning:** The contract will be sent/delivered after internal review.

*   **Identify the context:** This is a business/professional context (email, meeting response). The tone should be professional and polite.

*   **Generate English translations:**
    *   *Direct:* I will send the contract after internal review.
    *   *More formal/business standard:* I will provide the contract following an internal review.
    *   *Emphasizing the process (common in business):* We will share/send the contract once it has been internally reviewed.

*   **Select the best options (offering variety):**
    1.  Formal (standard business): "We will send the contract after internal review."
    2.  Slightly more formal (process-oriented): "We will provide the agreement once it has undergone internal review."
    3.  Concise (quick response): "I will send the contract after internal approval." (Assuming review implies approval)

*   **Final selection (Korean users often prefer the most natural business phrasing):** Provide the most common and versatile options. (Self-correction: Using "we" is often safer than "I" in Korean business contexts, even if one person handles it).
